title: Post-Review Remediation Cycle
source: Full project review — architecture, code quality, security, devops
manual_actions_required: Revoke NVIDIA API keys immediately at build.nvidia.com (keys are live — cannot be automated)
Run BFG Repo-Cleaner or git filter-repo to purge .env/.env.local from git history
gate: Can users ship with Ultra-Dex after this cycle?
completion_criteria: No exposed secrets in repo or git history
Build scripts execute without silent failures
Test coverage >= 50% for src/core/orchestration and src/core/agents
noImplicitAny: true passing with zero type errors
npm audit returns zero HIGH or CRITICAL findings
